messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Airplane mode should be OFF for MMS to work—it disables all wireless communications, including cellular service and mobile data. Since you're seeing airplane mode is on, please turn it off.

Please run this fix on your phone:
- **toggle_airplane_mode** – This will turn Airplane Mode OFF.

After you turn it off, wait a moment for your signal bars to appear, then try sending an MMS message again. Let me know if it works, or if you still see issues.

I tried sending an MMS message again, but it's still not working. I'm quite frustrated. What else can we try? I hope we can fix this soon because I really need to send those pictures.

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
